evals.name: default-5-themes-2031
evals.prompt: Give me 5 thematic stock predictions for 2026-2031, US-listed and ADR small/mid-cap names only. Show your screening workings (universe → filters → survivors). Per ticker: thesis fit, catalyst, valuation/risk, edge + 5-year conviction. Cite sources for every pick and policy claim. End with the DD disclaimer.
evals.expected_output: 5 distinct themes, screening workings with survivor counts, 5-8 tickers/theme with 4 bullets each, conviction tiers, sources grouped, DD disclaimer verbatim

evals.name: single-theme-ai-infrastructure
evals.prompt: Thematic picks for the AI infrastructure theme — 2026-2031, small/mid-cap, with screening workings and citations
evals.expected_output: Single theme report focused on AI infrastructure, 5-8 tickers, full screening workings, citations

evals.name: screen-defense-stocks
evals.prompt: Screen me small-cap defense stocks for the next 5 years — show me the workings and the picks
evals.expected_output: Defense-themed report with explicit screening funnel, small/mid-cap only, 4-bullet picks, sources
